canonicalIngredients.name: ginger
observations: 1 tbsp grated + knob in stock (s3 only)

canonicalIngredients.name: chicken stock or water
observations: 6 cups stock simmered with veg scraps, ~5 cups used (s3)

canonicalIngredients.name: japanese curry roux block
observations: 1 x 92 g Golden Curry packet for 4 serves (s2)

canonicalIngredients.name: curry powder
observations: 1 1/2 tbsp (12 g) in base + 1 tbsp (8 g) in roux, Japanese-style (s3 only, scratch path)

canonicalIngredients.name: butter
observations: 3 tbsp / 42 g for roux (s3 only, scratch path)

canonicalIngredients.name: ground spices (cumin, coriander, turmeric, fenugreek)
observations: 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, 1/2 tsp turmeric, 1/4 tsp fenugreek (s3 only, scratch path)

canonicalIngredients.name: apple
observations: 1 medium, peeled and grated (s3 only, scratch path)

canonicalIngredients.name: dark chocolate
observations: optional 5 g square for depth (s3 only)

causalSequence: pound chicken breasts to ~1 cm even thickness
coat flour (or starch), then egg, then panko; press crumbs on
fry 175 C, 3-4 min per side, till deep golden and cooked through; drain on rack
saute onion (with garlic, ginger where used) till soft
add stock or water; boil, then simmer till vegetables tender (5-10+ min)
roux-block path: off heat, stir in curry blocks till dissolved; simmer till thickened

scratch path: bloom curry powder + spices with jammy onion, grated apple; simmer in stock, blend smooth; whisk into butter-flour-curry roux; season soy, worcestershire, ketchup, honey; simmer 10 min till glossy
plate rice, ladle curry over or beside, top with sliced katsu; garnish
techniqueFacts: three of four sources use packet Japanese curry roux blocks (Golden Curry named twice); one builds curry from scratch with butter-flour-curry-powder roux over a blended onion-apple-vegetable stock base
roux blocks are concentrated: s0 uses half a pack, s2 states a 92 g pack serves 4; dissolve off heat or after veg are tender, then simmer to thicken
all sources bread with panko; three use the classic flour-egg-panko three-dish dredge, s0 instead mixes egg + flour + garlic powder into a wet batter before panko
s3 dredges in potato starch instead of flour for a crispier crust
fry at 175 C / 350 F; two sources warn oil below ~160 C gives soggy, oily katsu; fry in batches to hold temperature
pounding to ~1 cm gives even, fast cooking (all sources); s2 halves each breast horizontally, s3 butterflies then halves into 4 cutlets
internal temperature 74 C / 165 F is the doneness check (s0, s3)
scratch path flavour levers: 25 min jammy onions, grated apple for sweetness, soy + worcestershire + ketchup + honey seasoning, optional 5 g dark chocolate for depth (s3)
store chicken and curry separately; re-crisp katsu in oven or air fryer ~190 C (s0, s1, s2)
s2 serves with shredded cabbage, spring onion and Japanese mayonnaise, restaurant-style
